paite: Huan Rehoboam Shekem ah ahoh hi. Israel tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa a amah bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
heading: Mallam Namte Helna / (2 Kro 10.1-19)
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu ana zak in Kumpipa Solomon kiang a pan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi a, Jeroboam ahihleh Aigupta gam a om ahi.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

paite: Amah ava samsak ua, Jeroboam leh Israel kikaikhawm tengteng ahong ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
english: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

paite: "Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah hi. Huaiziak in na pa hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua angak hon hihzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in ahong gen uhi.
english: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum sung va kikhinkhe phot unla; ka kiang ah hong pai nawn un," achi hi. Huchi in mite apaikheta uh.
english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in apa Solomon dam lai a, akiang a om upate kiang ah, "Hiai mite bangchi in ka dawng dia hon hilh mah dih uh," chi in adong hi.
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Tuni a hiai mite sikha a na om a, a-nna uh sem a, amau dawng a, akiang ua thuhoih na genleh, tangtawn in na sikha in a-om ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

paite: Himahleh upate hoihsak azui kei a, amah toh kivual tuailai akiang a omte adong zawta hi.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai mite, ka kiang a, na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol angak hon hihzangsak in, chi a hong gen mite bangchi in ka dawng dia, hon hilh mah dih uh," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

paite: Akhanvual tuailaite'n akiang ah, "Hiai mite, na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak thei mahmah a, nang hon hihzangsak dih ve, na kiang achi mite kiang ah, hichibang in chi inla, hichibang in akiang uah gen in.
english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

paite: 'Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutme alianzaw. Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na batsak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai ding hi. Ka pa'n zepna in ahon sawi a, ke'n aikam in ka hon sawi ding,' " achi hi.
english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam leh mi tengteng kumpipa'n ni thum nung chiang in, "Ka kiang ah hong nawn un," chi a ahilh bang in, ani thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ava hoh uhi.
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

paite: Kumpipa'n mite khauhtak in ana dawng a, upate hoihsak apompih kei hi.
english: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

paite: Tuailaite hoihsak bang in, "Ka pa'n na hakkol uh ana giksak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai dia, ka pa'n zepna in ahon na sawi a, ke'n ahihleh aikam in ka hon sawi ding," achi hi.
english: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n mite thu angaikheta kei; hiai bang a thil om TOUPA a pan lah ahi ngal a. TOUPA'N Shiloh mi Ahijah zang a Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a, athugen atungtun theihna ding ahi.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from Yahweh, that he might establish his word, which Yahweh spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

paite: Israel tengteng in kumpipa'n athugen uh apom kei chih atheih un, "David ah tantuan bang i nei ua? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei kei uh. Israelte aw, na puanin chiat uah pai un. David, na inkuan kingaihtuah in," chi in kumpipa adawng uh. Huchi in Israelte apuanin chiat uah apaita uhi.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

paite: Himahleh Judah khopite a teng Israel suante tung ah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasemte heutu Adoram asawl hi. Israel tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Huaiziak in Jerusalem a tai ding in kumpipa Rehoboam kintak in akangtalai ah atuang hi,
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in tuni tan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ana hel uhi.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel tengteng in Jeroboam ahong kik nawn chih azak un, kikaihkhawmna a hoh ding in asamsak ua, Israelte tung ah kumpipa in abawl uhi. Judah nam chih louh David inkote zui kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

paite: Jerusalem atuntak in Rehoboam in Israel inkote dou a Solomon tapa Rehoboam lalgam la nawn ding in Judah inkuan tengteng leh Benjamin nam a pan mihangsan atelkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiat akaikhawm hi.
heading: Shemaiah Thugenkholh / (2 Kro 11.1-4)
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

paite: Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

paite: Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah leh Benjamin inkuan tengteng kiang ah leh midang teng kiang ah,
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Va hohtou kei un. Israel suan na unaute va dou kei un. Na inn chiat uah pai nawn vek un. Hiai kei thilhih ahi, chi in gen in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA thu azui ua, TOUPA thu bang in akik nawn ua, apai nawn vekta uhi.
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s word, and returned and went their way, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam in Ephraim tanggam ah Shekem khua asat a, huai ah ateng hi. Huai a pan apawtkhia a, Penuel khua asat hi.
heading: Pathian A Pan Jeroboam Akiheimang
english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.

paite: Jeroboam in alungtang in, "Lalgam David inkote ahong hi nawn diam aw," achi hi.
english: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

paite: "Hiai mite Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a kithoihnate lan dia ahohtouh uleh alungtang un atoupa uh, Rehoboam, Judah gam kumpipa lam ah a-awn nawn mai ding. Huchi in kei ahon that ding ua, Judah gam kumpipa Rehoboam lam ah abelh nawn mai ding uh," achi hi.
english: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”

paite: Kumpipa'n mi adong a, dangka-eng in bawngnou lim nih abawl a; akiang uah, "Nou a ding in Jerusalem a hohtouh ahaksa lo tel hi. Aw, Israel en dih uh, Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhia na pathiante uh," achi hi.
english: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

paite: Huchi in khat Bethel ah akoih a, khat pen Dan ah akoih hi.
english: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

paite: Mipite lah hiai bawngnou lim khat be ding in Dan tanpha ava pai ziak un hiai khelhna ahong hita hi.
english: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

paite: Mun sang ah innte alam a, Levi suante hilou, miniampente lak a mi siampu in abawl hi.
english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

paite: Jeroboam in Judah gam a ankuanglui aneih mah bang un akha giatna, huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ding in asep hi. Maitam ah ahohtou a; Bethel ah abawngnou lim kiang ah akithoih hi. Mun sang abawlte ah siampute sep in Bethel ah akoih hi.
heading: Bethel A Biakna Mohpaih Ahi
english: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

paite: Ama'n adeih bang a, aseh kha mah, akha giatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Bethel a maitam abawl ah ahohtou hi. Israel suante a ding in ankuangluina asep a, maitam a gimlim hal ding in ahohtou hi.
english: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.
